subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this remain a separate WhatsApp 515 finalization tracker that requires restart-free live proof, or should it be folded into the phone-code login work as an accepted documented recovery sequence?
rationale: The current code already has a bounded 515 restart path, while the observed failure depends on an unmerged phone-code login surface and persisted auth readiness behavior that maintainers still need to accept or split.

options.title: Keep A Separate 515 Finalization Gate
options.body: Require the landing phone-code path to prove that gateway restart is not needed, or keep this issue open for a narrower recovery fix.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code Login
options.body: Treat the manual restart sequence as acceptable context for the phone-code feature and close this only after the phone-code PR lands with docs and proof.

options.title: Defer For More Live Evidence
options.body: Keep this issue waiting for redacted logs or a live WhatsApp relink reproduction before deciding the permanent recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep A Separate 515 Finalization Gate
recommendation.body: Require the landing phone-code path to prove that gateway restart is not needed, or keep this issue open for a narrower recovery fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public CLI/plugin API shape, WhatsApp-owned recovery behavior, and release-facing setup UX.
